name: pont au Change
locality: 1st arrondissement of Paris, 4th arrondissement of Paris
text: The Pont au Change (French pronunciation: [pɔ̃t‿o ʃɑ̃ʒ]) is a bridge over the Seine River in Paris, France. The bridge is located at the border between the first and fourth arrondissements. It connects the Île de la Cité from the Palais de Justice and the Conciergerie, to the Right Bank, at the Place du Châtelet.

depictions.name: Pont au Change
depictions.text: The Pont au Change is a bridge in Paris that connects the Île de la Cité to the northern bank of the Seine.
